links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified USFDA drug safety communications and medication guides
links.outcome: Readability (grade level) of simplified vs original documents, with technical accuracy and key message retention
links.effect: Original DSCs grade level 13, MGs 22. Single prompt - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0 10.1, Gemini 8; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0 7.1, Gemini 6.5. Multiple prompts - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0 10.3, Gemini 7.5; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0 8, Gemini 6.8. LLM outputs retained technical accuracy and key messages.
links.quote: LLMs significantly improved readability, reducing the grade levels to more accessible readings (Single prompt - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0© 10.1, Gemini© 8; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0© 7.1, Gemini© 6.5.

design_hint: reading-level constrained prompting for patient materials
